mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a cool 73 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Community Park. We are seeing a waning crescent moon and an air quality index of 51, so keep that in mind if you are heading outside.

In city news, the engineering department has released their latest reports, and the senior center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those interested in a scenic excursion.

There is plenty to do, with live music happening today at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee, and the Girls Try Hockey event taking place today at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can catch a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
During their recent patrol on Tuesday, the Verona Police Department managed to apprehend a suspect who attempted to flee from officers.
Culver's is serving up their Snickers Swirl flavor today until they close at 10 PM tonight, so make sure to stop by soon for a scoop.
